verdict.rationale: Llama's own CLI and docs let a developer select an exact versioned model ID, such as `--model-id "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct"` and `llama-model download --model-id CHOSEN_MODEL_ID`, so pinning is supported. Nothing shows floating aliases that track the latest release, or any documented alias-to-version policy. missing for 10: aliases that track the latest release, a documented alias-to-version mapping or policy, deprecation/lifecycle guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin an exact versioned model ID while aliases track the latest release, with the alias-to-version policy documented

citations.quote: Passing the following parameter to the script switches it to use Llama 3.1. --model-id "meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
